source_data.reference: body text (output/.transcripts_split when present, else output/.transcripts)

text_under_test.primary: liteparse adapter page text, OCR off, shipped normaliser applied
text_under_test.secondary: pypdf adapter page text, shipped normaliser applied
text_under_test.sanity_check: recomputed pypdf recall against the full transcription (output/.transcripts) equals frozen r_pypdf within 0.0001 on every page, else stop; quality classes use body recall

classes.junk: recall < 0.50 and at least one token

A2.name: script consistency
A2.rule: share of letters in the most frequent Unicode script; Common and Inherited excluded

A.fallback_A1: word-shape ratio: 2-20 letters, one script, no letter repeated 3 times in a row, Latin tokens hold a vowel; used only if wordfreq is not approved, recorded as an amendment before the run

B.runtime: onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider, numpy encoder port, no PyTorch

request.question: Is this text readable writing in a natural language, rather than garbled or broken OCR output?

C.model: jev-latest (TypeSafe hosted System One; response model id recorded per page)

request.question: Is this text readable writing in a natural language, rather than garbled or broken OCR output?

C.equal_cost: threshold chosen on these pages by the same rule as A and B
C.status: post-verdict arm under amendment A3; cannot change the frozen main verdict

B2.basis: candidate B (same pinned model, encoder, question and options)
B2.state: first 2000 characters of page text, the same input as candidate C
B2.reason: B read whole pages up to 8192 tokens; the publisher's inference-policy.json states calibration null and long-context task accuracy not established

D.name: cascade: A screens, hosted Jev (W1, candidate C scores) confirms
D.screen: A flags a page as suspect when s_A is below the A threshold that flags 20% of the other documents' healthy LiteParse pages
D.confirm: Jev scores only suspect pages; a page is flagged when it is suspect and s_C is below a threshold chosen on the other documents so the combined healthy false-positive rate is at most 0.02
D.reported: held-out flags, gates G1 to G3, share of pages sent to Jev
D.status: registered 2026-10-07 under A3 before D was computed; offline from saved A and C scores

D_julia.name: cascade: A screens, Julia 1 confirms (B2 scores, first 2000 characters, W1)
D_julia.rule: identical to D: same screen rates 0.20 primary, 0.10 and 0.30 sensitivity, same held-out thresholds
D_julia.reason: operator asked for a fair comparison: D used Jev only
D_julia.status: registered 2026-10-07 under A3 before D_julia was computed; offline from saved A and B2 scores

E.model: openjev/openjev-MLX-4bit (Loop AI OpenJev, CC BY-NC 4.0, research use)
E.runtime: helper/shim.py and shim_mlx.py at revision 1c341f65bfe5d50fdb935c71e9739c9e0938d6c4 (helper sha 81a22f1b), mlx 0.32.2, mlx-lm 0.31.3, transformers 5.17.0, Python 3.12, isolated venv; server bound to 127.0.0.1, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
E.request: same /v1/systemone noul request as C: wordings W1 to W3, first 2000 characters of page text
candidates_reported: E_sel (wording chosen per document by nested leave-one-document-out)
D_openjev (A screens, OpenJev W1 confirms, same rates as D)
E.status: registered 2026-10-07 under A3 before any OpenJev scoring; operator approved the 15 GB download and the non-commercial licence for this research run

operating_points: equal cost: per held-out document, threshold where healthy false-positive rate = 0.02 on the other documents' healthy pages (A3)

G3.scope: both operating points reported; gated at equal cost

P0.rule: >= 99 of 100 argmax matches and <= 0.01 absolute logit error on parity-cases.json
P0.on_fail: stop; operator chooses isolated environment or torch extra

routing_simulation.rule: a document routes when flagged pages that the shipped chain rescued reach 10% of its pages, or when it routed in the Experiment 33 sampled_baseline arm

adoption.paired_test: exact one-sided McNemar on junk pages, p < 0.05
adoption.margin_reason: about 105 junk pages give a 95% half-width of 0.06-0.10 on recall between 0.5 and 0.9; a smaller gap is inside sampling noise, and Julia 1 adds a 580 MB download, a runtime path, an index identity input and about 0.18 s per page
adoption.false_positive_reason: 2% of about 536 healthy pages is about 11 pages, five times below the 10% document fraction; G2 catches clustered false positives

false_positive_cost.basis: Experiment 34 state files; Experiment 33 read time 9.27 s over 1,123 pages

cloud: none for A and B; hosted Jev (TypeSafe AI) approved by operator on 2026-10-07 for arm C only under amendment A3: first 2000 characters of each page text, including personal records, are sent to api.typesafe.ai; closed weights
production_change: none; a recommendation opens a separate proposal

decision_register.item: wordfreq as an experiment-only tool (uv run --with wordfreq==3.1.1)
Julia 1 ONNX download, approximately 614 MB including tokeniser

amendments.change: Added a post-verdict follow-up (tasks 8.1 and 8.2, design D7): score the selected signal on the 464 saved Experiment 33 local OCR texts and report AUC for body_recall < 0.5 on the 399 gated pages and on io06. Added a Non-Goal: OpenJev (Verdict) is not an arm of this experiment.
amendments.reason: Experiment 39 (FAIL, report on branch feat/experiment-39-local-tier-escalation) left io06 and Latin handwriting open. The follow-up reuses this experiment's signal, prompt and threshold.

amendments.change: Compare all-text pypdf recall with frozen r_pypdf for the sanity check; continue using body-only recall for quality classes.
amendments.reason: Experiment 33 build_labels._evidence calculates r_pypdf against the full transcription. The initial check stopped on bd02 p005: full-text recall 0.3078556263 agrees with frozen 0.3079; body recall is 0.9666666667. Saved and newly extracted pypdf text agree against each reference.

amendments.change: Jev (TypeSafe jev-latest) becomes registered candidate C in the protocol, with the same Julia question, flag rule and gates G1 to G3. Equal-cost thresholds move to leave-one-document-out so a threshold is never chosen on the pages it is tested on. The whole experiment is rerun with A, B and C; the first run is a pilot.
amendments.reason: Operator decision 2026-10-07: nothing is committed or merged to v3, so the protocol is edited in place.
limits: Not blind: the pilot already showed Jev ahead on the same 40 documents.
Jev is closed weights; jev-latest is an alias, every row stores the returned model id.
Page text (first 2000 characters) is sent to api.typesafe.ai.

additions.change: Register B2: Julia 1 on the first 2000 characters of each page, so B and C read the same input. Noul parity is structural only: the encoder is token-identical to the publisher's julia/data.py and differs from the parity-tested choice path only by head text and qtype id 2; full noul logit parity needs the PyTorch reference (Ask).

wordings.state: first 2000 characters of page text for both models

W1.question: Is this text readable writing in a natural language, rather than garbled or broken OCR output?
W1.note: frozen question; Julia W1 = B2, Jev W1 = C

W2.question: Is this OCR text usable as the real content of the page?
W2.false: Garbled OCR: random characters, broken or invented words, symbols inside words, or text that does not form real words, sentences or labels
W2.true: Usable text: real words in any language, including tables, lists, headings, numbers and short labels, even with a few OCR errors

W3.question: This page text is mostly real words in a natural language, with only minor OCR errors.

how_sent.jev: noul instructions = question; criteria {true, false} only when not plain yes/no

wordings.selection: nested leave-one-document-out: for each held-out document, pick the wording with the highest junk-vs-healthy AUC on the other documents' LiteParse pages, then take that wording's equal-cost threshold from the same other documents
wordings.report: all wordings are reported; the nested selection is the result used for gates
